description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:420-422, 760-786 — The Lint trait's applies_to() doc says 'The runner uses this to skip check_cert for positions that don't match'. However, run_path() does not consult applies_to() at all — it unconditionally invokes check_path on every path-scope lint. A lint declared with applies_to = Leaf and scope = Path would have its applies_to value silently ignored. The trait doc does not state this limitation. Fix: either (a) document in the applies_to() doc that it is only meaningful for Certificate-scope lints, or (b) apply applies_to() filtering in run_path by passing the leaf as the check kind.
title: Lint::applies_to() contract undefined for path-scope lints
